authority_note: This checkpoint does not modify companies/PANW/latest.json or current registry authority. Current canonical authority remains the 2026-09-06 preliminary review until a separate canonical harness run promotes it.
review_method: 사용자 제공 PANW IR/SEC 5개 링크 및 동일 공시의 공식 company/SEC equivalents를 구조화·교차검증한 비권위 초벌 체크포인트
portfolio_context: 실제 보유·세금·위험예산 및 동기화 현재가 미제공. 신규 매수 승인·자동 매매·기존 보유 강제 청산 아님.
structural_thesis: Network & AI Security, Cortex, Cloud, Identity를 묶는 플랫폼화와 약 80% subscription/support 매출 구조가 NGS ARR·RPO 성장을 견인한다.
customer_and_moat: Q4 FY2026 NGS ARR $9.10B(+63%)와 RPO $21.2B(+34%)는 플랫폼 채택 확대를 지지하지만 대형 LLM 고객 및 인수 기여가 섞여 있어 유기적 retention·win-rate 검증이 필요하다.
current_finding: FY2026 잠정 매출은 $11.48B(+24.5%), 회사 정의 FCF는 $4.113B이지만 GAAP 영업마진은 6.1%로 FY2025 13.5%에서 하락했고 CyberArk 인수 및 SBC가 주당 경제의 핵심 검증 항목이 됐다.
economic_finding: 현금창출력은 강하지만 CyberArk $21.1B 인수, goodwill+intangibles의 자산 비중 약 59.9%, 높은 SBC를 감안하면 증분 ROIC와 owner cash per share는 아직 확정할 수 없다.
capital_and_survival: 2026-07-31 잠정 cash+investments $7.906B, long-term convertible notes $1.774B, FY2026 OCF $4.553B으로 생존성은 강하다. 다만 2026-04-30 purchase commitments $8.6B와 대형 M&A 통합 리스크를 추적한다.
next_evidence: 동기화 현재가·9% reverse DCF, CyberArk/Chronosphere 유기적 ARR 분해, M&A 증분 ROIC, retention/win-rate, SBC·환매·M&A 주식수 브리지, FY2026 audited 10-K
permanent_loss_case: 대형 M&A가 낮은 증분 현금수익률을 기록하고 SBC·주식발행이 지속되는 동안 시장가격이 높은 성장 기대를 선반영해 주당 내재가치가 장기간 회복되지 않는 경우
falsifiers: NGS ARR·RPO 성장 둔화가 retention 또는 competitive win-rate 악화와 동반됨
CyberArk 포함 인수자본의 3~5년 세후 증분 현금수익률이 9% 요구수익률에 미달함
SBC와 M&A 발행 이후 FCF/share가 지속적으로 정체 또는 감소함
FY2026 audited 10-K에서 현재 잠정치 또는 내부통제 판단을 훼손하는 중대한 이슈가 확인됨
increase_evidence: 유기적 NGS ARR·RPO·renewal 성장과 독립적 win-rate 개선
CyberArk 교차판매·시너지로 9%를 유의하게 상회하는 증분 ROIC
SBC 포함 주당 현금흐름 성장과 순희석 억제
9% reverse DCF에서 현실적 Base 이하 기대가 현재 가격에 반영됨
sell_evidence: 플랫폼화 지표가 둔화하는 가운데 M&A 통합비용·SBC가 구조적으로 증가
대형 인수의 goodwill 손상 또는 현금수익률 붕괴
현재 가격이 실현 가능성이 낮은 FY2030 bull case를 요구

evidence: FY2026 revenue +24.5%; Q4 NGS ARR $9.10B +63%; RPO $21.2B +34%; FY2027 revenue guidance +23~24%
counter_evidence: FY2026 ARR includes acquisition effects and a nine-figure contribution from one large LLM customer migration
missing_data: organic ARR bridge by platform and acquisition

evidence: Subscription/support remains ~80% of revenue; RPO growth supports contracted customer demand; 70,000+ customers reported in Q4 release
counter_evidence: Independent renewal, NRR, cohort retention and price realization are not in supplied sources
missing_data: NRR/renewal by platform, independent customer ROI, competitive win-rate

evidence: NGS ARR and RPO accelerated; broad platform strategy spans network, security operations, cloud and identity
counter_evidence: CyberArk/Chronosphere contribution obscures organic moat trajectory; distributor concentration remains meaningful
missing_data: organic vs acquired ARR, retention, cross-sell cohort data

evidence: FY2026 OCF $4.553B and company FCF $4.113B; nine-month OCF grew 18.6%
counter_evidence: CyberArk purchase consideration $21.1B; goodwill+intangibles ~59.9% of preliminary FY2026 assets; high SBC and M&A share issuance; GAAP operating margin fell
missing_data: 3-5 year acquisition ROIC bridge, owner FCF/share normalization, maintenance vs growth investment

evidence: Platform strategy has produced rapid ARR/RPO growth; FY2026 $1.0B nine-month repurchases partially offset employee issuance
counter_evidence: CyberArk is a very large $21.1B capital allocation decision; recurring acquisition/SBC adjustments are material; FY2025 had no common-stock repurchases
missing_data: post-deal synergy realization, acquisition ROIC, full share-count bridge

evidence: Preliminary FY2026 cash+investments $7.906B vs $1.774B long-term convertible notes; FY2026 OCF $4.553B; no Credit Agreement draw at 2026-04-30
counter_evidence: Purchase commitments were $8.6B at 2026-04-30; acquisition integration expands liabilities and execution obligations

evidence: FY2027 company revenue guidance $14.1-$14.2B and FY2030 NGS ARR target $20B provide explicit expectations to test
counter_evidence: No synchronized current quote or reverse DCF in supplied source set

evidence: Cybersecurity platformization and AI security can support power-law upside if cross-platform economics scale
counter_evidence: Asymmetry cannot be assessed without price; large acquisition capital and dilution can reduce per-share upside

evidence: FY2025 10-K received unqualified financial-statement opinion and effective ICFR opinion; no FY2026 audit opinion inferred from the unaudited 8-K release
FY2026 preliminary cash+investments $7.906B, OCF $4.553B, convertible notes $1.774B; no credit agreement balance at Apr. 30
items.resolution_needed: Reconcile audited FY2026 commitments and maturities

evidence: FY2026 weighted diluted shares rose ~7.8%; 112M shares were issued for acquisition; SBC remains high and must be separated from M&A issuance
items.resolution_needed: 4-quarter gross issuance, SBC vesting, tax withholding, repurchase and M&A share bridge

evidence: Revenue growth is accompanied by NGS ARR, RPO and operating cash flow growth; FY2026 OCF $4.553B
items.resolution_needed: Decompose organic versus acquired growth and large LLM customer contribution

evidence: CyberArk purchase consideration $21.1B with $14.8B goodwill and $6.3B identified intangibles; return on this capital is not yet observable
items.resolution_needed: 3-5 year post-tax incremental cash return and synergy bridge versus 9% hurdle

evidence: NGS ARR/RPO are strong but supplied sources lack independent renewal, retention and win-rate evidence; acquisition effects are material
items.resolution_needed: Organic platform cohorts, retention, NRR, price realization and competitive win-rate

evidence: No synchronized current quote or reverse DCF was provided/run in this source-bound checkpoint
items.resolution_needed: Current quote plus 9% reverse DCF and Bear/Base/Bull scenarios

evidence: No single end customer exceeded 10% of FY2025 revenue; distributor concentration was meaningful but not individually fatal and declined to top-two 31% of nine-month FY2026 revenue
items.resolution_needed: Monitor distributor sell-through and any large-customer/platform concentration

evidence: Valuation is not established and large M&A plus dilution can create permanent per-share value loss even if revenue grows
items.resolution_needed: Reverse DCF, acquisition ROIC and per-share cash compounding stress test
